documents.title: B.A.D. — basketball action detection
documents.text:
in progress private repository

A zero-shot system that watches a basketball clip and names the offensive play being run: pick and roll, horns, floppy, or transition.

A Roboflow computer vision model detects players, the ball, and the rim. A vision-language model (Qwen3-VL) watches the annotated video and returns the play in strict JSON. Ariya’s build script generates the notebook.
